## What changed

Describe the externally observable behavior and the module interface it uses.

## Verification

- [ ] `make quality`
- [ ] `make gen` leaves the working tree unchanged
- [ ] Authorized provider smoke evidence is attached when capability claims
      changed

## Module design

- [ ] The change deepens an existing module or identifies why a new module is
      necessary
- [ ] New interfaces have at least two justified adapters
- [ ] Tests use the same interface as callers and do not reach through it
- [ ] Source and comments contain no Chinese characters or emoji
